entities.summary: Adèle de Batz de Trenquelléon, FMI, religious name Mary of the Conception, , was a religious sister and the co-founder of the Marianist Sisters with William Joseph Chaminade. The religious institute in the Roman Catholic Church was founded to serve the poor.
